findings.issue: Module-level log() calls datetime.now() directly instead of going through the injected clock, technically outside the three allowed live/time sources in the strategy contract.
findings.fix: Harmless today because backtest_nifty_direction_ce_pe.py:45 monkey-patches strat.log = sim_log before the Strategy runs, and log() only affects printed/saved text, not decisions. For robustness, consider having Strategy use self.now() inside its own logging helper instead of relying on a module-level function being monkey-patched externally.
